discovery.note: Catalog starts with SNKRDUNK Hottest Items on product pages (example https://snkrdunk.com/en/trading-cards/704407?slide=right, API /en/v1/brands/pokemon/streetwears?department=tradingCard), then fills from search sort=hottest. Cap 200 (160 PSA10 + 40 sealed). A scrape under 80 cards does not replace the watchlist. Pinned cards stay. Same set and collector number keeps its existing id. A headline under min_list_price_hkd (HK$100) is not added. Brand-API minPrice is already HKD; search tiles are yen × fx_jpy_to_hkd. The live list also drops a card whose sell ask, or last sold when there is no ask, is under that floor.
discovery.liquidity_score_note: liquidity_score is an absolute 0–99 (the same sales and listings score the same on another day; it is not a percentile of today's watchlist, which would spread scores but make 80 incomparable across days). Sold side (max 60): 60 * log1p(sales) / log1p(80). Sales are SNKRDUNK trades in about 7 days — PSA10 one-week chart, else sealed sales-history dates inside 7 days. Yahoo today+7d volume is used only when that sold count is 0. Book side (max 39): 39 * log1p(listings) / log1p(800). Listings are the current sell book — usedListingCount for a slab, listingCount for a sealed box. About 80 sales or about 800 listings fill that side. A typical Hottest card lands in the mid range; 99 needs both a deep sale week and a deep book.
